metadata.title: मोदी सरकार के क़ानून को मिज़ोरम ने किया ख़ारिज | How Mizoram has opposed a law of Modi government
metadata.description: Recently, Mizoram assembly had passed an unanimous resolution against the Forest Conservation (Amendment) Act 2023. Specially northeastern states could be affected because of this amendment, where Centre can use these forest lands which falls within the 100 Km from the International borders without any forest clearance. However,  Constitution has special provisions regarding the use of forest land in North-East as many of these are administered by the tribes under their customary laws. This video tries to explain this issue and the constitutional provisions, and, is this a novel problem or is it an existing issue?
